en: This is an old green and white postage stamp featuring intricate Islamic geometric patterns as a border. In the center, there is an illustration of a building with a domed roof and several connected houses, possibly in an Ottoman architectural style. The stamp contains Arabic script, including calligraphic text at the top and bottom, as well as a tughra (Ottoman royal monogram) in a small circle at the top.
